Her face has a compact near-equal width-to-length silhouette, softly rounded temples and cheek contours, smooth continuous jaw arcs without angular corners, and a short softly curved chin. Use distortion-controlled portrait perspective and soft frontal shape light. Use the attached image only as an appearance reference for a generally visible adult, without claiming identity; the specified face-shape geometry takes precedence over its facial outline.
